resources.string:
1. Turn on your phone hotspot.
2. Start the server in this app.
3. Connect another device to your hotspot.
4. In a browser on that device, open the URL shown above.
 If “★ http://drop:PORT” appears, try that first.
 If it does not load, use the IP address URL — it always works.
5. Upload or download files from the browser.
Connect the phone to hotspot or Wi-Fi, then start the server.
Connected devices can upload to the phone and download shared files from it.
(mDNS unavailable on this hotspot — use the IP URL above)
